metadata.title: Instability of Böhm's Einstein metrics
metadata.abstract: Böhm metrics on $S^{k+1}\times S^l$ and $S^{k+l+1}$ ($k,l\geqslant 2$, $k+l\leqslant 8$) occur in sequences of Einstein metrics that converge to a cone. We prove that, along such a sequence, the number of negative eigenvalues of the Lichnerowicz Laplacian acting on transverse-traceless tensors tends to infinity: these metrics become increasingly unstable. This result gives a partial answer to a conjecture of Gibbons, Hartnoll and Pope concerning the instability of the generalised black hole spacetimes built from Böhm metrics.

analysis.workSummary: 研究趋向锥极限的 Böhm Einstein 度量序列，证明 Lichnerowicz Laplacian 在横向无迹张量上的负特征值数趋于无穷。
analysis.breakthrough: 定量显示这些度量随退化越来越不稳定，并部分回答相关广义黑洞时空稳定性猜想。
analysis.limitations: 只覆盖指定低维 Böhm 序列，尚非所有 Einstein 锥退化的统一结论。
analysis.priorityReason: 100 分制：相关性 22/30、新颖性与强度 17/25、技术复用性 13/20、潜在影响 10/15、证据清晰度 8/10，总分 70/100。
